summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB filed a Form 6-K on June 26, 2026, reporting a registered direct offering of 400,000 ADSs and warrants to purchase up to 300,000 ADSs, priced at $10.00 per ADS, for aggregate gross proceeds of $4.0 million. Maxim Group LLC acted as sole placement agent. The securities were offered under an existing shelf registration statement. Proceeds will advance global expansion and AI infrastructure. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
